summary: TEMA Middleware Phase 2 backend fully validated. Build, lint, 71 unit tests, 18 e2e tests all pass. OpenAPI paths exactly match the 4 foundation endpoints (/health, /ready, /version, /health/integrations) — no invented business/SQL routes. Runtime smoke on port 8110 (integrations disabled) returns expected UP/READY/DISABLED responses; correlation-id echo and consistent NOT_FOUND envelope confirmed. Enabled-but-unreachable scenario on port 8111 degrades safely with status=DOWN + latencyMs + generic 'Connectivity check failed'; SECRET LEAKAGE CHECK: password 'SuperSecretPass123' appears 0 times in HTTP response and 0 times in /tmp/tema8111.log. Config validation rejects invalid SQL_SERVER_ENABLED=yes and SAGE_X3_AUTH_TYPE=oauth-magic at startup.
critical_code_review_comments: Foundation is clean and disciplined — no invented Sage/SQL business endpoints as required by problem statement.
describeTarget in SQL adapter and Sage client correctly hide credentials; connectivity failures return generic 'Connectivity check failed' with no exception details leaking to clients.
Env validation via class-validator/Joi throws on startup for invalid enum/boolean values — good fail-fast behavior.
test_credentials: None required — integrations disabled by default; unit tests mock external systems.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node/NestJS project at /app/tema-middleware, NOT the pod's FastAPI/React stack. Do NOT use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or supervisor. Start manually: `NODE_ENV=production TEMA_PORT=<port> node dist/main.js &`, sleep 4s, curl localhost, then `pkill -f dist/main.js`. All 71 unit + 18 e2e Jest tests pass. Phase 2 foundations only — no business endpoints exist yet.
